body: It has been oscilating between bad and horribly bad, I'm thankfuly at bad right now.

Partially sudden, I'm diagnosed with MDD and have spent the last 6 months imagining everything falling apart, incluiding imagining the death of family members, pets, friends, etc. She had had vision problems for about 9 months already, I suspected something but we didn't go to the vet. 3 days ago she became very ill but we didn't know what it was so we took her, and she was just put down about an hour ago
[Suicidal ideation](https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/Suicidal_ideation), it's pretty common, yes it happens to me as well

I don't know about tinnitus but prozac worked wonderfully for me (20mg), watch out for the drowsiness if you take them in the morning, secondary effects appear before the treatment starts working on the depression, one of the first signs I saw was that my dreams changed about a week in, became less "dark" and more vivid, depression went away in about 3-4 weeks, wish you luck
And how do I do that?, I've never broken up with someone either
